newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nam Pei Hong H1 net loss HK$85.14 mln.
newsitem.headline: Nam Pei Hong H1 net loss HK$85.14 mln.

text.p: Company name Nam Pei Hong (Holding) Ltd

NOTE - Nam Pei Hong is a chinese medicine and health food retailer and manufacturer. Net is after exceptional losses of HK$65.40 million on shortfall in inventories and HK$0.63 million on disposal of fixed assets, and provisions of HK$7.88 million for doubtful debts, HK$1.0 million for deposit paid for purchase of goods, HK$2.0 million for deposit paid for proposed investment in a cattle farm, and HK$1.12 million for diminution in value of China joint ventures.

The calculation of loss per share is based on the weighted average of 224.18 million shares vs 157.64 million shares as adjusted for the bonus issue of share distributed on February 5, 1996 and the rights issue of shares made during the period.
